video_title: 🚨 Jaylen Brown releases statement on trade to the 76ers 🚨 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown felt disrespected by the Celtics' handling of trade discussions
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown has been disappointed and disrespected over the way the Celtics have handled this trade situation
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown has been disappointed and disrespected over the way the Celtics have handled this trade situation, particularly because he never formally requested a trade. But now he has to move on, and that preparation for the 76ers and the next phase of his career has begun. He has already spoken to the team's cornerstone guards Tyrese Maxey and BJ Edgcumbe. They had great early conversations in the first 24 hours of this trade.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics traded Jaylen Brown after failing to secure a contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Once the Celtics missed out on Giannis Antetokounmpo for the fourth straight year, Jaylen Brown dangled in trade conversations
quotes.quote: Once the Celtics missed out on Giannis Antetokounmpo for the fourth straight year, Jaylen Brown dangled in trade conversations. My understanding was Jaylen Brown felt disrespected, and the only way to recoup that relationship at that point was to give Jaylen Brown that two-year $145 million extension in July. But all the indications now are that the Celtics were not going to offer that. So then it became about seeing what can you get on the trade market.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics set a high asking price for Jaylen Brown in trade talks
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics set a very high bar. They asked teams for four, five first-round picks
quotes.quote: The Celtics set a very high bar. They asked teams for four, five first-round picks. But that price just was not met in the marketplace, and as time went on, as they aggressively shopped him among eight to 10 different teams, the valuation plummeted for Jaylen Brown across the NBA. And when I talk to teams today, they wonder why didn't the Celtics prolong this later into July, later into the off-season?

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics decided to move on from the Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown duo
quotes.excerpt: They made the assessment internally that they were not going to move forward with both Jayson Tatum
quotes.quote: Go back to 2022, Jaylen Brown was offered for Kevin Durant. And even last summer, the Celtics listened, took calls on Jaylen Brown. They were open to moving him. The necessary offers obviously weren't put into form, so they decided to keep him. They moved Kristaps Porzingis and Jrue Holiday instead. But this summer is when the Celtics became serious about moving Jaylen Brown. They made the assessment internally that they were not going to move forward with both Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown as the supermax duo to lead this team to a championship.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers sign Anfernee Simons to two-year deal to bolster bench scoring
quotes.excerpt: They've reached agreement with guard Anfernee Simons on a two-year $12.3 million deal
quotes.quote: The 76ers added some more firepower today. They've reached agreement with guard Anfernee Simons on a two-year $12.3 million deal. Think about what Simons is going to give this team offensively. Last season, they were a bottom-three offensive bench unit. Simons ranked among the top six in three-pointers made coming off the bench last season. Think about Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown. We know how much they love to drive. Well, now you have that knockdown shooter. And I'm told the 76ers are also trying to make a pitch to LeBron James along with the Warriors, the Cavaliers, and the Heat.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes Brad Stevens for handling of Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: Brad Stevens, you failed this. You failed this. As a former Celtic player for the Celtic nation
quotes.quote: Brad Stevens, you failed this. You failed this. As a former Celtic player for the Celtic nation, you dropped the ball completely throughout this whole process. For the first time throughout this process, Brad Stevens didn't know his ass from his elbow. And he completely dropped the ball from the Giannis situation all across the board. We're still talking about Jaylen Brown here, and you gift-wrapped it, the Philadelphia 76ers, an opportunity to the NBA Finals. Jaylen Brown is one of those dudes. He was the reason why Nico went away from Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown deserves better treatment after his tenure with the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: When you think about what Jaylen Brown has done in the Boston Celtic uniform for his resume
quotes.quote: When you think about guys like Cornbread Maxwell, who got his jersey retired hanging up in the rafters, Finals MVP, NBA champion, and you think about what Jaylen Brown has done in the Boston Celtic uniform for his resume, he didn't deserve to be treated this way. And you can tell in this statement, I didn't see a thank you to the organization, I didn't see a thank you to the head coach, I didn't see a thank you to his teammates. He feels some type of way and he should.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst explains the league's valuation of Jaylen Brown's contract
quotes.excerpt: The league doesn't value what he produces at his salary slot. At 57 million what he produces
quotes.quote: It wasn't that the league doesn't think Jaylen Brown is a great player or an excellent player. It's that the league doesn't value what he produces at his salary slot. At 57 million what he produces. And that is why he was traded and that is why he was traded for relatively so little. As the Celtics evaluated where they were as an organization and evaluated where they have to operate in this new world of aprons and hard salary caps, they said they had to move off from a player of his production level at that salary number.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics struggled to find trade partners for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Trust that the Celtics were involved in some of those talks. They couldn't get in on any
quotes.quote: Trust that the Celtics were involved in some of those talks. They couldn't get in on any of those other star players, not just Giannis. Other players that where they were involved for. And as the more they looked at it, I think the lesser and you look at all these teams that made deals, Hannah, over the last week, these star players that got traded, trust that the Celtics were involved in some of those talks. They couldn't get in on any of those other star players, not just Giannis. Other players that where they were involved for.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins blames Brad Stevens for the low trade return
quotes.excerpt: I got to blame Brad for that. Because if Jaylen Brown was made available after the Giannis deal
quotes.quote: I got to blame Brad for that. Because if Jaylen Brown was made available after the Giannis deal and they wasn't tied to that, I don't believe that his value is that low. I believe that teams prayed on the Boston Celtics because they knew that they had to get rid of him, because he dropped the ball previously in the Giannis deal.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks notes the high asking price deterred potential trade partners
quotes.excerpt: The asking price was so high that teams didn't feel like they needed to go back
quotes.quote: The asking price was so high that teams didn't feel like they needed to go back and negotiate. And what happened was, because we're in this free agent window that started over the weekend or early this week, everybody moved on to their own other business. Teams went out and made trades, teams went out and signed players. So by the time this kind of came back, we were out of it.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks evaluates the 76ers' acquisition of Paul George
quotes.excerpt: Now you trade him with two picks and you get a top 10 player back
quotes.quote: And when you look at the Philadelphia 76ers, they're the last man standing, right? They had a Paul George, a player that, listen, you had to basically attach to a pick if you were just looking to move off him. Now you trade him with two picks and you get a top 10 player back. That's where teams are trying to grab their mind around.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst highlights the emotional factor in the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: They can understand the raw emotion of revenge. Because I will tell you this, this is a grade
quotes.quote: One thing that people can understand that beyond all this nuance and cap analysis and analytics and whatever, they can understand this. They can understand the raw emotion of revenge. Because I will tell you this, this is a grade A revenge situation that now the Jaylen Brown enters, playing in the division, probable playoff opponent, routine playoff opponent. You know they're going to get prime time games. All four of those games are going to be prime time. You're going to be on Christmas Day.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst believes Jaylen Brown is seething over the trade
quotes.excerpt: He was seething underneath those words. He's going to carry that over to the 76ers
quotes.quote: He was seething underneath those words. He's going to carry that over to the 76ers and he's going to be able to shove it down the Celtics' throat. And the Celtics meanwhile will be able to say we can live, we believe in our, they've made big trades before that have ended up working out for them. They'll say we'll live better and we'll see how Jaylen Brown lives.
